column1: # Local mutation manifest for the commander title-truncation fix,
# kept out of the shared tests/mutations.tsv for the same reason the
# commander_prompt manifest is: mutate.sh maps suite names in its own
# suite_path(), and the shared manifest is a batch other tasks run against.
# Disable the clip: titles ride through uncut, so the round event's created
# tasks carry the original 71/48-char titles instead of the 40-char bound.

column3: s|            candidate\["title"\] = _commander_clip_title(original_title)|            candidate["title"] = original_title  # MUT: no clip|

column1: # Restore the old hard rejection: one overlong title voids the whole round
# and the commander burns all three attempts.

column3: s|^            original_title = candidate\["title"\]$|            raise ValueError("candidate title exceeds 40 characters")  # MUT|

column1: # Drop the fleet add stderr warning: human overlong titles enqueue silently.

column3: s|    if len(title) > COMMANDER_TITLE_MAX_CHARS:|    if False:  # MUT|
